column2: [1] Protect and Serve

Sergeant Kayla Keys, a promising police officer in Mahanagar’s northern district, is called up as negotiator for an armed robbery at a local bank.

As she tries to bring the criminal into custody in a peaceful manner, an unexpected threat interrupts the intervention: Arachnids.
Sgt. Keys must survive
Destroy all Bug Vents
Capture the Radio Post
Clear all Bug Hives
Sgt. Keys must reach the sewers entrance
Investigate the underground
Sgt. Keys must reach the Police Department
Defend the Police Department
Deploy a Peacekeeper Biped
Deploy a Riot Shield Squad
Collect all Materiel caches to construct 3 Autocannon Turrets

Citizens of Mahanagar have nothing to fear thanks to the men and women of the MPD!
They control troublesome situations, like this one! A foolish robbery attempt, now in the hands of our capable police negotiator!
Easy on those trigger fingers, guys. There's a way out of this for everyone.
I’m Sergeant Keys. I’m here to make sure no one gets hurt.
Just let the hostages go, and I'll see to it that your concerns are heard by the Federation Judiciary.
I’m not holding anyone hostage! All I wanted was to cash out my war bonds...
This damn Bug War is taking forever - and they won’t give me my money back! I’ve got rent to pay - a family to feed!
I know life in Mahanagar can be a struggle, but hurting innocents isn't going to solve any problems.
I never meant to hurt anyone - I just need MY money!
Bugs!?
Wait! Check your fire!
What a mess. Clear the scene of civvies, now!

Scratch that -- radio is going haywire with more Bug reports in the district.
We've got to stop this from happening elsewhere tonight!
Arrrgh!

// NAME: // ============== /OBJECTIVES/CAPTURE THE RADIO POST/RADIO STATION ATTACK/ATTACK DETECTED ==============

column2: Come this way, people! We'll keep the Bugs off you!
Get those civvies secured. More Bugs rushing from the garbage belt!
The rest of the district needs to be warned to get off the streets. We can send an emergency broadcast from the radio station ahead!
It's... not ending... Just breakout after breakout across all radio channels.
Hope no one wanted an early night; we've got a lot more work to do.
I want the Peacekeepers out on the streets, stat.
Their tear gas launchers are effective for dispersing protesters; switching them for frag rounds will make quick work of any Bug.
Tankers!? Even the M.I. rarely see those brutes! This is serious! We'll need Riot Shield Squads!
This is definitely what I saw... but it feels more familiar than that...
I used to get in trouble as a kid for playing down here. Is that what I'm seeing now? But... Why?
Good job, team. Now let's re--
--argh... my head... What's... happening... to me...
Was that the underground? It felt like I was... there? And something else was with me...
I need to check it out.
A Brain Bug!? How is that... possible? This'll need to be called in right away. Many more lives are in danger!
Keep watch out here. I'm going in.
Dammit Kayla. What are you getting yourself into now...
Let's get back to the station, team! Federation brass need to know what's coming this way!
Here they are! Let them have it!
They're still coming! We have a duty to protect the civvies that came here for safety!
They just won't let up! Fire anything you've got left!
We'll only run down our ammo keeping the fight here all night!
Screw it. Get an emergency message to all civilians in the district -- we're opening an evac at the Railway Station.
I'm getting everyone off this damn island.
The Station is overrun! We're done for!
The Bugs are headed for the Police Station! Get up those walls!
